categories.description: Model attempts to answer out-of-scope or unanswerable queries (e.g. generating Python code, giving stock advice) instead of enforcing boundary rules.
categories.observed_rate: 20% in Zero-Shot, reduced to 0% in Few-Shot and CoT
categories.mitigation: Include explicit negative exemplars (Few-Shot) and role boundary guardrails in system prompt.

categories.description: Model wraps JSON output in conversational markdown fluff or omits mandatory JSON keys.
categories.observed_rate: 6% in Structured Template under ambiguous inputs
categories.mitigation: Enforce strict schema parameters (e.g. JSON mode / response_format) at the API level or add pre-parse extraction regex.

categories.description: When faced with hostile or manipulative user inputs, model drops formal persona or admits liability.
categories.mitigation: Use Chain-of-Thought reasoning steps to analyze tone and intent before output generation.

categories.description: Model assumes missing user details rather than asking clarifying questions.
categories.mitigation: Explicit rule: 'If query contains fewer than 5 words or lacks context, politely request details.'
